description:
Cast First Day of School, causing it so that each creature that enters the battlefield under your control this turn gets a +1/+1 counter put on it and gains haste until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer, sacrificing Murderous Redcap to scry one.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
First Day of School triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
